34866 का इकाई अंक कितना है?
questions.s:
The concept of cyclicity is used to identify the last digit of the number.

Cyclicity chart:

NumberCyclicityUnit digit values
Power 1Power 2Power 3Power 4

(Note: when remainder is 0, power = cyclicity)

In 34866:

Unit digit of 348 is 8.

From the cyclicity chart, cyclicity of 8 is 4.

So, we have to divide the power of 348 i.e.66 by 4.

After dividing 66 by 4, remainder = 2. So, power ≠ cyclicity

Unit digit of 82 = 4

So, unit digit of 34866 = 4

questions.q:
What is the unit digit of (116111 + 39256 + 108123 - 66493)?

(116111 + 39256 + 108123 - 66493) का इकाई अंक कितना है?
questions.s:
The concept of cyclicity is used to identify the last digit of the number.

In 116111:

Unit digit of 116 is 6 and cyclicity of 6 is 1.

So, we have to divide the power of 116 i.e.111 by 1.

After dividing 111 by 1, remainder = 0. So, power = cyclicity = 1

Unit digit of 61 = 6

In 39256:

Unit digit of 392 is 2 and cyclicity of 2 is 4.

So, we have to divide the power of 392 i.e.56 by 4.

After dividing 56 by 4, remainder = 0. So, power = cyclicity = 4

Unit digit of 24 = 6

In 108123:

Unit digit of 108 is 8 and cyclicity of 8 is 4.

So, we have to divide the power of 108 i.e.123 by 4.

After dividing 123 by 4, remainder = 3. So, power ≠ cyclicity

Unit digit of 83 = 2

In 66493:

Unit digit of 664 is 4 and cyclicity of 4 is 2.

So, we have to divide the power of 664 i.e.93 by 2.

After dividing 93 by 2, remainder = 1. So, power ≠cyclicity

Unit digit of 41 = 4

Therefore, unit digit of (116111 + 39256 + 108123 - 66493)

= unit digit of (6 + 6 + 2 - 4)

= 0

questions.q: 1. The price of 3 notebooks and 6 pen is Rs. 3000. With the same money one can buy a notebooks and 12 pen. Raju wants to buy 15 pen, how much will he have to pay ?
questions.s:
1.(a)
Let the CP of notebook and pen be N and P respectively
ATQ,
3N + 6P = 3,000 ---------- (1)
N + 12P = 3,000 ---------- (2)
From equation(1) and (2) we have ;
3N + 6P = N + 12P
2N = 6P
N = 3P
Putting N= 3P in equation(2) we have ;
3P + 12P = 3,000
15P = 3,000
So, the cost price of 15 pens = ₹3,000

questions.q: 6. Find the greatest value of k for which the 6-digit number 24312k is divisible by 6.
questions.s:

Sum of digits of 24312k = 2+4+3+1+2+k = 12 + k

As k is unit digit it should be even and also a multiple of 3 so that (k + 12) is multiple of 3.

So, k = 6

questions.q: 3. A 4-digit number "34PQ" divisible by 3,5 and 7. Find the value of P + Q .
questions.s:
3.(a) If the number is divisible by 5 means the last digit is either 0 or 5.
Let Q = 0
Now we have to find the value of P.
For divisibility by 3, the sum of the digits should be divisible by 3.
⇒ P = 2, 5, 8
But the numbers 3420, 3450 and 3480 are not divisible by 7.
Now, take the value of Q = 5.
For divisibility by 3, we get,
P = 3, 6, 9
But by checking for divisibility by 7, we get P = 6.
Hence, P + Q = 6 + 5 = 11.

questions.q:
What is the average of two consecutive even numbers, if the difference of whose square is 132?

दो क्रमागत सम संख्याओं का औसत क्या है, जिनके वर्ग का अंतर 132 है?
questions.s:
Let the numbers be a and (a + 2).

(a + 2)2 - a2 = 132

a2 + 4 + 4a - a2 = 132

4a + 4 = 132

4a = 128

a = 32

So, (a+2) = 32 + 2 = 34

Hence, the required average = (32 + 34)/2 = 33

questions.q:
If the average of 5 numbers 2m - 1, 56, 128, 11 and 3m is 47.8, then the value of 'm' is equal to -

questions.s:
Average = (sum of observations)/(number of observations)

Then, 47.8 = (2m - 1 + 56 + 128 + 11 + 3m)/5

239 = 5m + 194

5m = 45

m = 9

questions.s:

NumbersCyclicity
1, 5, 61
4, 92
2, 3, 7, 84

The unit digit of the series will be the unit digits of sum of unit digits of individual terms of the series.

Unit digit of 321 = 31 = 3

Unit digit of 323 = 33 = 7

Unit digit of 324 = 30 = 1

Sum of unit digits of all terms = 2 * (3 + 9 + 7 + 1) = 40

Unit digit of the series = 0

questions_hin.q_hi: 1. 3 नोटबुक और 6 पेन का मूल्य 3000 रुपए है। उतने ही पैसों से एक व्यक्ति एक नोटबुक और 12 पेन खरीद सकता है। यदि राजू 15 पेन खरीदना चाहता है, तो उसे कितना भुगतान करना होगा ?
questions_hin.s_hi:
1.(a)
माना नोटबुक और पेन का क्रय मूल्य क्रमशः N और P है
प्रश्न के अनुसार,
3N + 6P = 3,000 ---------- (1)
N + 12P = 3,000 ---------- (2)
समीकरण (1) और (2) से हमारे पास है;
3N + 6P = N + 12P
2N = 6P
N = 3P
समीकरण(2) में N = 3P रखने पर हमें प्राप्त होता है;
3P + 12P = 3,000
15P = 3,000
तो, 15 पेन का क्रय मूल्य = ₹3,000

24312k के अंकों का योग = 2+4+3+1+2+k = 12 + k

चूंकि k इकाई अंक है, यह सम होना चाहिए और 3 का गुणज भी होना चाहिए ताकि (k + 12) 3 का गुणज हो।

तो, k = 6

questions_hin.q_hi:
31 X 68 X ? X 42 has unit's digit 6. Find the value that will replace "?".

31 X 68 X ? X 42 का इकाई अंक 6 है। वह मान ज्ञात कीजिए जो "?" के स्थान पर आएगा।
questions_hin.s_hi:
• 31 → 1; 68 → 8 → 1 X 8 = 8

• 42 → 2 → 8 X 2 = 16 → unit digit = 6

• Let the missing digit be d: 6 X d ≡ 6 (mod 10) → d = 1

questions_hin.q_hi:
What is the average of two consecutive even numbers, if the difference of whose square is 132?

दो क्रमागत सम संख्याओं का औसत क्या है, जिनके वर्ग का अंतर 132 है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Let the numbers be a and (a + 2).

(a + 2)2 - a2 = 132

a2 + 4 + 4a - a2 = 132

4a + 4 = 132

4a = 128

a = 32

So, (a+2) = 32 + 2 = 34

Hence, the required average = (32 + 34)/2 = 33

questions_hin.q_hi: 9. यदि 4 अंको की संख्या 48ab, 2, 5 और 7 से विभाज्य है, तो (10a - b) का मान क्या है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
9.(d) प्रश्न के अनुसार,

questions_hin.q_hi:
If the average of 5 numbers 2m - 1, 56, 128, 11 and 3m is 47.8, then the value of 'm' is equal to -

यदि 5 संख्याओं 2m - 1, 56, 128, 11 और 3m का औसत 47.8 है, तो 'm' का मान किसके बराबर है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Average = (sum of observations)/(number of observations)

Then, 47.8 = (2m - 1 + 56 + 128 + 11 + 3m)/5

239 = 5m + 194

5m = 45

m = 9

questions_hin.q_hi:
What is the unit digit of 321 + 322 + 323 + 324 + ..... Up to 8 terms?

321 + 322 + 323 + 324 + ..... 8 पदों तक का इकाई अंक क्या होगा?
questions_hin.s_hi:
8th term of the series will be 328.

The cyclicity of the numbers is given below in the table:

NumbersCyclicity
1, 5, 61
4, 92
2, 3, 7, 84

The unit digit of the series will be the unit digits of sum of unit digits of individual terms of the series.

Unit digit of 321 = 31 = 3

Unit digit of 322 = 32 = 9

Unit digit of 323 = 33 = 7

Unit digit of 324 = 30 = 1

Sum of unit digits of all terms = 2 * (3 + 9 + 7 + 1) = 40

Unit digit of the series = 0
